summary.en: The Sudanese army and the Rapid Support Forces have intensified drone attacks, with a strike on a market in Abyei killing more than 150 civilians. RSF fighters have deliberately targeted hospitals in el-Fasher, further restricting medical care. Drought and El Niño are increasing famine risk across war-torn Sudan. The UN is resuming peace efforts to end the drone war and address the humanitarian crisis. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren og RSF-militsen har økt droneangrepene, og et angrep på et marked i Abyei drepte mer enn 150 sivile. RSF-militsens soldater har bevisst rettet angrep mot sykehus i el-Fasher, noe som ytterligere begrenser helsehjelpen. Tørke og El Niño øker sultfaren i det krigsherjede Sudan. FN gjenopptar fredsarbeidet for å få slutt på dronekrigen og håndtere den humanitære krisen. 4 680 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
